name: @cmdgen/desktop
author: OpenCmdGenerator contributors
//: The one deliberate exception to 'no runtime dependencies': node-pty backs the Run feature's real interactive shell and ships a native binary tsup cannot bundle, so it stays a real dependency (see electron-builder.config.cjs's files/asarUnpack and pnpm-workspace.yaml's onlyBuiltDependencies). Everything else is still fully bundled by tsup. @cmdgen/web is a devDependency that is never imported — it exists so Turborepo orders the web build before build:renderer copies its output. The electron version is pinned exactly because electron-builder downloads binaries for one specific release and refuses a range.
